sophia_sales: Heads-up — FortuneCorp is asking for SIG/CAIQ + our DPA with SCCs before the POC kickoff. Also asked specific privacy language around data deletion and whether customer data could be used for training. Can we consolidate what to send?

mike_s: We can provide our SIG/CAIQ answers and the standard DPA. We also have SCC addendum included in the DPA for EU customers. For the training question: we do NOT use customer data to train Redwood models by default.

ria_legal: Confirming: our DPA includes SCCs (2021 clauses) and a Data Processing Addendum section that covers subprocessors, international transfers, and deletion. I can extract the exact clause to paste into the customer's template if they want.

alyssa_revops: Quick Q — the customer wants evidence for vendor risk: SOC 2 type II, pen test summary, and a network diagram. Do we have updated artifacts ready to share?

jordan_eng: We have a current SOC2 report (Q4 2025) and a summarized pen test findings doc. For the network diagram, we can provide a redacted topology for Redwood Hosted. Note: don't include internal IPs.

mike_s: Regarding privacy controls to call out in the SIG answers: encryption at rest (AES-256), TLS 1.2+ in transit, KMS-integrated key management (customer-managed keys on Dedicated/Private), role-based access controls, logging/audit trails, automated KV/prefix cache scrubbing options for POCs if they want minimal retention.

ria_legal: DSARs/data deletion: our standard SLA is 30 days to respond to DSARs and 14 days to complete account-level data deletion once validated. We can commit to contract language: "Redwood will respond to a DSAR within 30 calendar days and execute verified data deletion within 14 calendar days of request acceptance."

sophia_sales: Perfect. They also asked whether we support SCCs for subprocessor lists — they want to see the list of subprocessors and our subprocessors' locations. Is that ok?

mike_s: We publish a subprocessors list; for Hosted we list cloud provider regions used. For Dedicated/Private we can provide on-prem detail in a separate attestation. Note: some subprocessors operate globally, but we can map by region on request.

alyssa_revops: Any redaction guidance we should give the customer when they send us their vendor questionnaire? They usually attach a very long matrix.

ria_legal: Ask them to highlight required fields and mark which items are must-haves vs. nice-to-have. If they send their DPA template, we can propose edits inline. For the SIG/CAIQ, request the specific sections they care about (e.g., cryptography, incident response) so we can prioritize.

jordan_eng: On the technical side, POC checklist we should share with customer: 1) sample request/response shapes (no real PII), 2) tokenization/retention defaults, 3) optional log redaction instructions, 4) endpoints for VPC/Private if they need air-gapped tests. Paste below a tiny retention config snippet we send to customers:

```json
{
  "retention_days": 14,
  "log_redaction": "enabled",
  "kv_cache_ttl": 0
}
```

mike_s: Also mention fallback and data-at-rest options: for POCs we can enable prefix caching off and set kv_cache_ttl to 0 to avoid persistent KV. For extra assurance we can run the POC on Dedicated capacity with CMEK so keys are under their control.

deploy-bot: Ticket created: SR-2026-7784 — "FortuneCorp vendor review — SIG/DPA artifacts" assigned to security. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.local/browse/SR-2026-7784

sophia_sales: Thanks all. Ria, can you paste the DPA deletion clause and the SCC addendum snippet here so I can drop into the customer's template? I can forward SOC2 + pen test + redacted network diag after Jordan uploads them to the secure share.

ria_legal: Pasted minimal clause below for copy/paste: 

"Data Deletion: Subject to any applicable legal obligations, Redwood will, upon Customer's written request, delete Customer Data within fourteen (14) calendar days following validation of the request. Redwood will provide a certification of deletion upon completion."

"Standard Contractual Clauses: The Parties agree to incorporate the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (C(2021) 8819 final) by reference in this DPA. Redwood shall provide executed SCC addenda upon request and will maintain a subprocessors list accessible to Customer."

mike_s: I'll attach a one-page summary of the security posture (encryption, logging, incident response SLA, pen test cadence) to the ticket.

alyssa_revops: Timeline check — POC kickoff targeted next Wed. Can we have a docs bundle to send by EOD Friday?

jordan_eng: I'll upload SOC2 redacted, pen test summary, and redacted network diagram to the secure share by tomorrow EOD.

ria_legal: I'll prepare the DPA snippet and SCC addendum text and drop it on the ticket today.

sophia_sales: Great — I'll combine and send to FortuneCorp once everything's on the ticket. If they push for faster turnaround on the DPA, ask them to mark it urgent and we'll fast-track review. :thumbsup:

mike_s: Also flagging customers who require modifications to SCCs — that'll need legal sign-off, but we can usually accept narrow edits.

sophia_sales: Awesome. Thanks team — will follow up after I get the artifacts.

alyssa_revops: +1 :rocket:
